## WAGES

(98)(a) General Increases. Employees whose straight time hourly wage rate was $29.10 or more as of September 14, 2020, shall receive an increase to their base wage rate (exclusive of shift premium, seven-day operator premium, and any other premiums) on the effective date of this Agreement in accordance with the table below.
